answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on a staked bond: before an agent may transact, its operator locks collateral any peer can slash on proof of misbehavior. Cloning an identity then costs one full bond each, so M clones need M times the capital, and the attack's expense follows a spiral with no volume discount. Bonds also tag accounts like timber is branded for provenance, while a yarrow-stalk flag marks revoked stakes.
